name: registry
title: Docker Registry
author: yunix-intel
description:
龙芯版说明

架构：linux/loong64（仅龙芯 3A5000/3A6000）

与上游差异：Go 单二进制；首次启动生成 htpasswd。

缺失功能：无 Web UI、无 TLS、无多实例共享存储；删除后需手动 GC。

额外依赖：持久化 /var/lib/registry 与 /auth；/auth/password 是唯一密码来源；Docker CLI 需 insecure-registries。

镜像说明：3.1.2；Go 单二进制；`/var/lib/registry`、`/auth`；5000；UID 1121；首启生成 admin 随机密码与 htpasswd；HTTP secret 持久化；无 TLS
description_en:
LoongArch notes

Architecture: linux/loong64 only

Differences: Single Go binary; htpasswd is generated on first start.

Missing features: No web UI, no TLS, no shared storage across instances; run GC manually after deletes.

Extra dependencies: Persist /var/lib/registry and /auth; /auth/password is the only password source; Docker CLI needs insecure-registries.

Image notes: 3.1.2；Go 单二进制；`/var/lib/registry`、`/auth`；5000；UID 1121；首启生成 admin 随机密码与 htpasswd；HTTP secret 持久化；无 TLS

notes: 首启生成 htpasswd；无 TLS；5000 固定端口。
未在 OpenWrt/iStoreOS 真机上执行安装回归；仅做 ipk 结构与 JSON schema 静态校验。
